purpose: Evaluate a robust, area-aware shared displacement field without temporal mean subtraction or raw-pixel filtering

unbounded_point_pilot.global_shift: Oracle best constant-vector fit to true displacement over scene mask, independently per frame
limits: Synthetic composed shears are not a full atmospheric or planetary rotation model.
Reference is fixed; Saturn source contains its existing reference texture and noise.
Noise is independent Gaussian with an illustrative amplitude, not a fitted sensor model.
Generation uses cubic interpolation; reconstruction uses the production bilinear sampler.
Blur is applied before geometric motion; reference does not share the extra blur.
All frames are retained; only the explicitly weighted case changes scalar contributions.
Image RMSE uses a noiseless oracle with identical reconstruction interpolation.
No photometric normalization or output smoothing is applied.

Same 5738 frames, scalar weights, reference and global shifts; no per-frame or final-stack normalization.
Raw coherent stack has no additional pixel filter. Only named matched comparison copies get AS-measured sigma-1 radius-3 smoothing.
All sharpened outputs use Wavelet 27/0/0/0 then Adaptive Deconvolution 15.6 with Contrast Adaptive.
Rejected fitted fields fall back to global translation; their frames still contribute to the stack.
Variation includes real detail and artifacts; ring widths include geometry and processing, not calibrated resolution.
The 75 overlapping windows are a sensitivity check, not independent statistical replicates.
Both individual-image and common PR centroids are reported to expose window-recentring effects.
This is one real capture; AS is a comparison output, not known geometric truth.

generation_parameters_reference: results/registration/local-warp-validation.json; unchanged cases(), default wavelengths 160/240 px, short cases 64/96 px
limits: Exploratory parameters were selected using synthetic cases, including short-wavelength cases; independent noise repeats use seed 9018.
The first point pilot had no support taper and is superseded; the current model reproduces the supported point and area-aware variants.
The selected model improves 12 of 14 primary clean-image cases, but stationary Saturn clean-image error regresses in both noise seeds.
Sharpened error and raw geometric error are different metrics; neither is pure sensor noise.
Real ring widths are descriptive, not calibrated resolution, and AS is not ground truth.
Unfiltered output remains noisier in fine-scale variation than the supplied AS image; measured AS smoothing remains relevant.
No production algorithm/default change; no controlled runtime benchmark was performed.
